desc:
A massive space combat mobile armor developed independently by Axis, using the newest technology of the time.
It is equipped with a number of beam weapons and high-output thrusters, and features Wired Claw Arm capable of unleashing an all-range attack even without Newtype capabilities.
Its defenses include a special device known as an I-Field generator that is able to disrupt enemy beam attacks.
But while it boasts overwhelming combat capabilities, it also places a huge burden on the pilot and requires serious skill to operate properly.
During the Delaz Conflict, it was sent as a parting gift for Operation Stardust from the Axis Advance Fleet to the Delaz Fleet.
Anavel Gato, the "Nightmare of Solomon," would use it in a fierce fight against the Federation fleet.

character.desc:
An officer in the Delaz Fleet. He is an ace pilot of the
Zeon forces who was feared as the "Nightmare of Solomon"
during the One Year War.
Talented enough to get into the modern history books, he is
best known for attacking the Federation Forces' Torrington
base and stealing the Gundam GP02.
Popular among subordinates and comrades, his proud spirit
and nobility give him the bearing and personality of a
warrior. The same traits cause him to dislike fellow Delaz
Fleet officer Cima Garahau, who has a dark side.
He is also an idealist who has a naive infatuation with the
Delaz Fleet leader Aiguille Delaz.
During the Delaz Conflict, he puts his life on the line to
realize the dream that Operation Stardust represents.
character.name: Anavel Gato

name: Neue Ziel (EX)

series.desc:
A half-century has passed since humanity began emigrating into outer space due to overpopulation.
Hundreds of gigantic space colonies now orbit Earth, humans living along the inner walls of the colonies' main cylinders.
With almost half of humankind residing in space, these colonies have become humanity's second home where people are born, raised...and die.
It is January 1, U.C. 0079.
The furthest cluster of colonies from Earth, Side 3, has proclaimed itself the Principality of Zeon and has launched a war of independence against the Earth Federation.
In just one month of fighting, war casualties have halved their respective populations. Humanity is disgusted at the atrocities they themselves have wrought.
Eight months have passed since the rebellion began. They were at a stalemate...
series.name: Mobile Suit Gundam

series.desc:
An OVA planned and produced by Sunrise, released on May 22nd, 1991.
The story follows young officer Kou Uraki three years after the One Year War of ""Mobile Suit Gundam.""
The OVA was followed on August 29th, 1992 with the theatrical release of ""Mobile Suit Gundam 0083: The Afterglow Of Zeon.""
In 1992, Kadokawa Shoten released a novel based on this work.
series.name: Mobile Suit Gundam 0083: Stardust Memory
